jobs.title: Index Customer Administration Specialist
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Index Customer Administration Specialist

Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Reference 8239

Du arbeitest für den Geschäftsbereich Index Services und bist verantwortlich für alle unterstützenden und administrativen Tätigkeiten im Index Business und Sales Support. Dich erwartet eine abwechslungsreiche Rolle an der Schnittstelle von Kunden, Datenmanagement, Finanzprodukten und Compliance. Ein erfahrenes und engagiertes Team unterstützt dich dabei, die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Stakeholder in den Mittelpunkt zu stellen.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Kundenstammpflege, Vertragsmanagement, Gebührenverrechnung und Mahnwesen; Freigabe von Daten/Services gemäss Kundenvereinbarungen

• Bearbeitung von Themen in Compliance, Legal und Quellensteuer; enge Abstimmung mit internen Fachstellen

• First Level Support hinsichtlich Finanzprodukten, Indexdaten, kommerziellen Vereinbarungen und technische Fragen; Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Daten-Vendoren und Geschäftspartnern

• Konsolidierung/Überwachung indexbasierter Produkte (Fonds, strukturierte Produkte, Derivate); Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Arbeitsprozessen, regulatorischen Berichten und Prozessdokumentationen

• Durchführung von Analysen, Statistiken und Reports; Mitarbeit in bereichsübergreifenden Projekten und strategischen Umsatzinitiativen; allgemeine Administration

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung; relevante Berufserfahrung im Finanzsektor

• Ausgeprägte Serviceorientierung sowie professionelles, überzeugendes Auftreten und klare Kommunikation

• Hohe Genauigkeit, Eigenverantwortung und strukturierte, zuverlässige Arbeitsweise; souverän im Management komplexer administrativer Aufgaben

• Starke Organisationsfähigkeit in einem dynamischen Umfeld Prioritäten zu setzen und den Überblick zu behalten

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (Spanisch von Vorteil); sehr gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, SAP-Erfahrung ist ein grosses Plus

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Payment Specialist (80 - 100%)
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Payment Specialist (80 - 100%)

Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office moeglich | Referenz 8193

Du möchtest unser Team im SIC Operations unterstützen und einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Qualität des Schweizer Finanzplatzes leisten? Dann freuen wir uns von dir zu hören. Viele Änderungen im Zahlungsverkehr müssen auch unsere Teilnehmer (Banken in der Schweiz und ganz Europa) rechtzeitig umsetzen. In dieser Funktion bist du die Überwachungs- und Anlaufzentrale für Support-Anfragen in Bezug zum elektronischen Zahlungsverkehr. Du arbeitest im Schichtbetrieb (Montag bis Freitag zwischen 06.30 – 19.30 Uhr) inkl. Pikett Einsätze (nach 1 Jahr) ausserhalb der Bürozeiten. Weiterhin hast du die Möglichkeit, in diversen Projekten mitzuarbeiten. Für diese abwechslungsreiche und spannende Position bieten wir ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell (SIX Office & Home Office) an.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• 1st und 2nd Level Support für den Schweizerischen Zahlungsverkehr (SIC – inkl. Instant Payments – und euroSIC)

• Überwachung der Zahlungssysteme (SIC/euroSIC/SWIFT) und der technischen Verbindungen

• Verwaltung und Pflege der Teilnehmerstammdaten

• Koordination mit der Schweizerischen Nationalbank sowie der Swiss Euro Clearing Bank

• Teilnahme an fachspezifischen Notfallübungen sowie Mitarbeit in Projekten

• Verschiedene administrative Arbeiten

Das bringst du mit

• Kaufmännische Grundausbildung (Kaufmännische Berufslehre, Handelsschule oder gleichwertige Ausbildung), Erfahrung im Zahlungsverkehr von Vorteil

• Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit (Montag bis Freitag: Zwischen 06.30 – 19.30 Uhr)

• Nach ca. 1 Jahr: Bereitschaft für Pikettdienst ausserhalb der Bürozeiten inkl. Wochenende/Feiertage

• Ein hohes Mass an Selbstständigkeit und Hilfsbereitschaft

• Teamplayer und Freude am Kundenkontakt

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio etc.)

• Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, Französischkenntnisse ist ein Plus

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

descriptionByLocale.it:
SIX sta guidando la trasformazione dei mercati finanziari.

Ciò che ci distingue ci spinge avanti: tra radici locali e rilevanza globale, siamo un mix unico di tradizione e futuro, di fondazione e crescita. Apprezziamo le menti intelligenti e le ispiramo a crescere con le loro idee. Vieni a plasmare il futuro dei mercati finanziari con noi.

Specialista di pagamento (80 - 100%)

Zurigo | Fino al 40% Home Office possibile | Riferimento 8193

Vuoi sostenere il nostro team in SIC Operations e dare un importante contributo alla qualità del centro finanziario svizzero? Non vediamo l'ora di sentirti. Molti cambiamenti nelle transazioni di pagamento devono essere attuati anche dai nostri partecipanti (banche in Svizzera e in tutta Europa) in tempo utile. In questa funzione, sei il punto di monitoraggio e di contatto per le richieste di supporto per i pagamenti elettronici. Lavori in turni (dal lunedì al venerdì dalle 06.30 alle 19.30) incl. Incarichi Pikett (dopo 1 anno) fuori orario di ufficio. Inoltre, avete la possibilità di partecipare a vari progetti. Per questa posizione varia ed emozionante, offriamo un modello di lavoro ibrido (SIX Office & Home Office).

Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Sostegno di primo e secondo livello per i pagamenti svizzeri (SIC – incl.) Pagamenti istantanei – e euroSIC

• Supervisione dei sistemi di pagamento (SIC/euroSIC/SWIFT) e collegamenti tecnici

• Gestione e manutenzione dei dati master dei partecipanti

• Coordinamento con la Banca nazionale svizzera e la Banca svizzera per la compensazione dell'euro

• Partecipazione ad esercizi tecnici di emergenza e partecipazione a progetti

• Vari compiti amministrativi

Lo porti con te.

• Formazione commerciale di base (apprendistato commerciale, scuola commerciale o equivalente), esperienza nelle transazioni di pagamento

• Prontezza per il lavoro a turni (da lunedì a venerdì: dalle 06.30 alle 19.30)

• Dopo circa 1 anno: disponibilità per Pikettdienst fuori orario di ufficio incl. Weekend/vacanze

• Un alto grado di indipendenza e disponibilità

• Giocatore di squadra e piacere nel contatto con il cliente

• Conoscenza molto buona di MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio ecc.)

• Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese in parola e scrittura, la conoscenza del francese è un plus

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al numero +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questa vacanza, consideriamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo le applicazioni indipendentemente dal background personale.
descriptionByLocale.en:
SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us forward: Between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Payment Specialist (80 - 100%)

Zurich | up to 40% Home Office possible | Reference 8193

Would you like to support our team in SIC Operations and make an important contribution to the quality of the Swiss financial centre? We look forward to hearing from you. Many changes in payment transactions must also be implemented by our participants (banks in Switzerland and throughout Europe) in good time. In this function, you are the monitoring and contact point for support requests regarding electronic payments. You work in shifts (Monday to Friday between 06.30 – 19.30) incl. Pikett assignments (after 1 year) outside office hours. Furthermore, you have the opportunity to participate in various projects. For this varied and exciting position, we offer a hybrid working model (SIX Office & Home Office).

These are your tasks

• 1st and 2nd level support for Swiss payments (SIC – incl.) Instant Payments – and euroSIC

• Supervision of payment systems (SIC/euroSIC/SWIFT) and technical connections

• Management and maintenance of participant master data

• Coordination with the Swiss National Bank and the Swiss Euro Clearing Bank

• Participation in technical emergency exercises and participation in projects

• Various administrative tasks

You bring that with you

• Basic commercial training (commercial apprenticeship, commercial school or equivalent), experience in payment transactions beneficial

• Readiness for shift work (Monday to Friday: Between 06.30 and 19.30)

• After about 1 year: Readiness for Pikettdienst outside office hours incl. Weekend/holidays

• A high degree of independence and helpfulness

• Team player and pleasure in customer contact

• Very good knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio etc.)

• Very good German and English skills in word and writing, knowledge of French is a plus

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska on +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX dirige la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse à avancer : Entre racines locales et pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits intelligents et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir des marchés financiers avec nous.

Spécialiste des paiements (80 - 100%)

Zurich jusqu'à 40% Home Office possible

Souhaitez-vous soutenir notre équipe dans les opérations SIC et apporter une contribution importante à la qualité du centre financier suisse ? Nous avons hâte de vous entendre. De nombreux changements dans les transactions de paiement doivent également être mis en œuvre par nos participants (banques en Suisse et dans toute l'Europe) en temps utile. Dans cette fonction, vous êtes le point de contrôle et de contact pour les demandes de soutien concernant les paiements électroniques. Vous travaillez par équipes (du lundi au vendredi entre 06.30 et 19.30) incl. Affectations à Pikett (après 1 an) en dehors des heures de bureau. De plus, vous avez la possibilité de participer à divers projets. Pour cette position variée et passionnante, nous proposons un modèle de travail hybride (SIX Office & Home Office).

Ce sont vos tâches

• Soutien de premier et deuxième niveaux aux paiements suisses (SIC – y compris) Paiements instantanés – et euroSIC

• Surveillance des systèmes de paiement (SIC/eurosIC/SWIFT) et connexions techniques

• Gestion et tenue à jour des données de base des participants

• Coordination avec la Banque nationale suisse et la Banque suisse de compensation de l'euro

• Participation à des exercices techniques d ' urgence et participation à des projets

• Diverses tâches administratives

Apporte ça avec toi.

• Formation commerciale de base (apprentissage commercial, école commerciale ou équivalent), expérience dans les transactions de paiement bénéfiques

• Préparation au travail posté (du lundi au vendredi : entre 6 h 30 et 19 h 30)

• Après environ 1 an: Préparation pour Pikettdienst en dehors des heures de bureau incl. Fin de semaine/jour férié

• Un degré élevé d'indépendance et d'utilité

• Joueur d'équipe et plaisir dans le contact client

• Très bonne connaissance de MS Office (Word, Excel, Visio etc.)

• Très bonne maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture, connaissance du français est un plus

Si vous avez des questions, visitez notre page FAQ ou contactez Beata Czyzewska au +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Pour cette vacance, nous ne considérons que les demandes directes.

La diversité est importante pour nous, donc nous accueillons favorablement les applications indépendamment de leurs antécédents personnels.

jobs.title: Senior Observability Engineer
jobs.description:
What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Observability Engineer

Zurich |  up to 40% working from home possible | Reference 7664

The Senior Observability Engineer is a hands-on role focused on building and delivering observability and AIOps as a shared engineering capability and service. You will help establish how observability is designed, implemented, and consumed across teams, leading early onboardings and shaping practical standards, processes, and ways of working.

Working closely with platform, product, and application teams, you will translate requirements into actionable observability solutions, implement and operate core capabilities, and continuously improve how insights, alerting, and automation support reliable services. As a core contributor to the Observability & AIOps Center of Excellence, you will combine deep technical execution with strong ownership of service quality, operational readiness, and capability maturity

What You Will Do

• design, deploy, and operate observability and AIOps capabilities for cloud-native and hybrid environments, supporting reliable, production-grade services

• lead the onboarding of teams and services, defining and applying standards for telemetry instrumentation, collection, SLIs, SLOs, and alerting in real-world systems using OpenTelemetry

• work hands-on with engineering, SRE, and operations teams to gather requirements and translate them into actionable observability and automation solutions

• install, configure, fine-tune, and maintain OpenTelemetry Collectors and telemetry pipelines for applications and platforms

• build and maintain dashboards, alerting, and telemetry flows across distributed tracing, metrics, and logs, leveraging OpenTelemetry to deliver meaningful insights and reduce operational noise

• run and evolve observability services that support modern incident detection, investigation, and operational decision-making

• design, configure, and maintain integrations with event management and ticketing systems for alert routing, incident context, and operational workflows

What You Bring

• 8+ years of hands-on experience in observability, SRE, platform, or reliability engineering, including responsibility for production observability capabilities

• proven experience taking observability capabilities from requirements to production-ready solutions; experience limited to dashboards, queries, or observability backends as a consumer is not sufficient

• practical experience instrumenting applications and infrastructure with OpenTelemetry to generate traces, metrics, and logs

• strong understanding of modern, trace-centric observability practices beyond traditional log-centric monitoring

• experience deploying, configuring, and operating OpenTelemetry Collectors and designing telemetry pipelines is a strong advantage; these will be key hands-on responsibilities in the role

• experience with cloud-native environments, operating Kubernetes-based workloads

• experience with common observability toolchains and backends (e.g.: Elastic, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, etc.) - Elastic Stack experience considered a plus

• scripting or automation skills to support repeatable deployment, configuration, validation, and ongoing operations using technologies such as Helm, Terraform, and Ansible

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Aiuterai a stabilire come l'osservabilità è progettata, implementata e consumata tra i team, leader nei primi cicli di imbarco e modellando standard pratici, processi e modi di lavoro.

Lavorando a stretto contatto con team di piattaforme, prodotti e applicazioni, tradurrai i requisiti in soluzioni di osservabilità attuabili, implementerai e gestirai le funzionalità principali e migliorerai continuamente come le informazioni, l'allerta e l'automazione supportano servizi affidabili. Come contributore principale al Centro di eccellenza per l'osservabilità e gli AIOps, combinerai una profonda esecuzione tecnica con una forte proprietà della qualità del servizio, della prontezza operativa e della maturità delle capacità

Cosa farai?

- progettazione, distribuzione e funzionamento di funzionalità di osservazione e AIOps per ambienti cloud-nativi e ibridi, supportando servizi affidabili e di qualità produttiva - guidano l'onboarding di team e servizi, definendo e applicando standard per strumentazione telemetrica, raccolta, SLI, SLO e allertando in sistemi reali utilizzando OpenTelemetry - lavorano con team di ingegneria, SRE e operativi per raccogliere requisiti e tradurli in soluzioni di automazione e osservabilità azionabili - installare, configurare, mettere a punto e mantenere OpenTelemetry Collectors e tubazioni telemetrali per

applicazioni e piattaforme - costruire e mantenere dashboard, avvisi e flussi telemetrici attraverso tracciatura distribuita, metriche e log, sfruttando OpenTelemetry per fornire informazioni significative e ridurre il rumore operativo - eseguire e sviluppare servizi di osservabilità che supportano il rilevamento, l'indagine e il processo decisionale degli incidenti moderni - progettazione, configurazione e mantenimento delle integrazioni con sistemi di gestione degli eventi e di ticketing per il routing di allerta, contesto incidente e flussi di lavoro operativi

Cosa porti?

- 8+ anni di esperienza pratica nell'ingegneria dell'osservabilità, dell'SRE, della piattaforma o dell'affidabilità, compresa la responsabilità per le capacità di osservabilità della produzione - esperienza comprovata che assume capacità di osservabilità dai requisiti alle soluzioni di produzione-ready; esperienza limitata a dashboard, domande o backend di osservabilità come consumatore non è sufficiente - esperienza pratica che strumentalizza applicazioni e infrastrutture con OpenTelemetry per generare tracce, metriche e log - comprensione forte delle pratiche moderne di osservabilità trace-centriche oltre al tradizionale log-centrico

monitoraggio - esperienza di distribuzione, di gestione e di gestione di OpenTelemetry Collectors e progettazione di condotte di telemetria è un forte vantaggio; queste saranno responsabilità fondamentali nel ruolo - esperienza con ambienti cloud-native, gestione di carichi di lavoro basati su Kubernetes - esperienza con comuni toolchains e backend di osservabilità (ad esempio: Elastic, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, ecc.) - esperienza Elastic Stack considerata una plus - capacità di scripting o automazione per supportare la distribuzione ripetibile, configurazione, validazione e operazioni in corso utilizzando tecnologie come

Timoniere, Terraform e Ansible

Contatto

Se avete domande, date un'occhiata alla nostra pagina FAQ o chiamate Beata Czyzewska all' +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questo posto vacante accettiamo solo domande dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Désignation des marchandises

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse à l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous valorisons les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Ingénieur principal de la surveillance

Zurich, jusqu'à 40% de travail à domicile possible, Référence 7664

L'ingénieur principal de la visibilité est un rôle pratique axé sur la mise en place et la prestation de services de visibilité et d'IAOps comme une capacité et un service d'ingénierie partagés. Vous aiderez à déterminer comment la visibilité est conçue, mise en œuvre et consommée entre les équipes, en dirigeant les premières arrivées et en élaborant des normes pratiques, des processus et des méthodes de travail.

En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de plate-forme, de produit et d'application, vous transformez les exigences en solutions de observabilité actionnables, vous implémentez et exploitez des capacités de base et améliorez continuellement la façon dont les informations, l'alerte et l'automatisation soutiennent des services fiables.

Ce que vous ferez

- concevoir, déployer et exploiter des capacités de visibilité et d'IAOps pour les environnements cloud-natifs et hybrides, soutenir des services fiables et de qualité de production - diriger l'embarquement des équipes et des services, définir et appliquer des normes pour l'instrumentation de la télémétrie, la collecte, les SLI, les SLO et l'alerte dans les systèmes du monde réel utilisant OpenTelemetry - travailler main-sur-le-champ avec les équipes d'ingénierie, SRE et opérations pour rassembler les exigences et les traduire en solutions de visibilité et d'automatisation pratiques - installer, configurer, affiner et entretenir OpenTelemetry Collectors et les pipelines de télémétrie pour

applications et plateformes - construire et maintenir des tableaux de bord, des alertes et des flux de télémétrie dans les systèmes de repérage, de mesure et de registres distribués, en tirant parti d'OpenTelemetry pour fournir des informations utiles et réduire le bruit opérationnel - exécuter et développer des services de observabilité qui appuient la détection des incidents, les enquêtes et la prise de décisions opérationnelles modernes - concevoir, configurer et maintenir des intégrations avec les systèmes de gestion des événements et de billetterie pour l'acheminement des alertes, le contexte des incidents et les flux de travail opérationnels

Ce que vous apportez

- 8 ans et plus d'expérience pratique en matière de observabilité, d'ERS, de plate-forme ou d'ingénierie de la fiabilité, y compris la responsabilité des capacités de la production en matière de observabilité - expérience éprouvée en prenant des capacités de observabilité des exigences aux solutions prêtes à la production; expérience limitée aux tableaux de bord, aux requêtes ou aux outils de la observabilité en tant que consommateur n'est pas suffisante - expérience pratique en instrumentant des applications et des infrastructures avec OpenTelemetry pour générer des traces, des métriques et des journaux - compréhension solide des pratiques modernes de la observabilité en tant que centre des traces au-delà des pratiques traditionnelles

monitoring - expérience de déploiement, de configuration et d'exploitation OpenTelemetry Les collecteurs et la conception de pipelines de télémétrie sont un avantage important; ce seront des responsabilités clés dans le rôle - expérience avec les environnements natifs du cloud, fonctionnement des charges de travail basées sur Kubernetes - expérience avec des chaînes d'outils et des moteurs de visualisation communs (ex. : Elastic, Grafana, Dynatrace, Datadog, AppDynamics, etc.) - expérience Elastic Stack considérée comme un plus - compétences en script ou en automatisation pour soutenir le déploiement répétable, la configuration, la validation et les opérations en cours utilisant des technologies telles que

Helm, Terraform et Ansible

SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Senior Sales & Account Manager/in Banking Romandie (80-100%)

Genf, Zurich |  Bis zu 40% Home office | Referenz 8257

Möchtest du den Ausbau unserer Kundenbeziehungen in der Romandie aktiv mitgestalten? Verfügst du über ein starkes Netzwerk im Schweizer Bankenmarkt und bewegst dich souverän an der Schnittstelle von Kunden, Business und Technologie? Als Senior Sales & Account Manager Banking Romandie entwickelst du bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter, erschliesst neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten und positionierst unsere Lösungen in den Bereichen Cards, ATM, TWINT, Fraud & Dispute sowie Banking Services erfolgreich im Markt. Mit deinem Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse und deinem unternehmerischen Denken leistest du einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum unseres Geschäfts in der Westschweiz.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung eines Portfolios von Banken und Finanzinstituten in der Romandie

• Aufbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen sowie Identifikation und Gewinnung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten

• Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Kunden- und Wachstumsstrategien sowie aktive Mitgestaltung der Marktbearbeitung in der Romandie

• Positionierung und Vermarktung unserer Lösungen in den Bereichen Cards & Issuing Services, ATM Services, TWINT Services, Fraud & Dispute Services sowie Banking & Processing Services

• Führung von Verkaufs-, Angebots- und Vertragsprozessen bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss und Beratung von Banken bei strategischen, operativen und technischen Fragestellungen

Das bringst du mit

• mehrjährige Erfahrung im Sales, Business Development oder Account Management im Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld mit fundierten Kenntnissen des Schweizer Bankenmarktes

• starkes Netzwerk bei Banken und Finanzinstituten, vorzugsweise in der Romandie, sowie nachweisbare Erfolge im Aufbau von Neugeschäft und der Weiterentwicklung von Kundenbeziehungen

• Verständnis moderner Banking-, Payments- und Plattformlösungen sowie die Fähigkeit, technische und geschäftliche Themen adressatengerecht zu vermitteln

• strategische, unternehmerische und eigenverantwortliche Persönlichkeit mit hoher Umsetzungsstärke, Kundenorientierung, Verhandlungsgeschick und sicherem Auftreten bis auf Senior-Management-Stufe

• Französisch auf Muttersprachniveau sowie fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; hohe Kundenpräsenz in der Romandie sowie regelmässige Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams in Zürich (Arbeitsort Zürich oder Genf)

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Beata Czyzewska  unter der Nummer +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Disponete di una solida rete nel mercato bancario svizzero e avete fiducia nell'interfaccia tra clienti, business e tecnologia? In qualità di Senior Sales & Account Manager Banking Svizzera romanda svilupperai ulteriormente i rapporti con i clienti esistenti, aprirai nuove opportunità commerciali e posizionerai con successo sul mercato le nostre soluzioni nei settori carte, bancomat, TWINT, frodi e controversie e servizi bancari. Questi sono i tuoi compiti

• Sostegno e ulteriore sviluppo di un portafoglio di banche e istituti finanziari nella Svizzera romanda

• Costruire relazioni a lungo termine con i clienti e identificare e acquisire nuove opportunità di business

• Sviluppo e attuazione di strategie per la clientela e di crescita nonché partecipazione attiva allo sviluppo del mercato nella Svizzera romanda

• Posizionamento e commercializzazione delle nostre soluzioni nei settori Carte & Issuing Services, Servizi ATM, Servizi TWINT, Fraud & Dispute Services e Banking & Processing Services

• Gestione dei processi di vendita, offerta e contratto fino al completamento con successo e consulenza alle banche su questioni strategiche, operative e tecniche

Questo è quello che porti con te

• Esperienza pluriennale nelle vendite, nello sviluppo aziendale o nella gestione dei conti nel settore dei servizi finanziari con conoscenza approfondita del mercato bancario svizzero

• Forte rete presso banche e istituti finanziari, preferibilmente nella Svizzera romanda, nonché comprovato successo nella creazione di nuove attività e nell'ulteriore sviluppo delle relazioni con i clienti

• Comprensione delle moderne soluzioni bancarie, di pagamento e delle piattaforme, nonché capacità di trasmettere argomenti tecnici e commerciali in modo appropriato

• personalità strategica, imprenditoriale e responsabile con elevate capacità di implementazione, orientamento al cliente, capacità di negoziazione e un atteggiamento fiducioso fino al livello di senior management

• Francese a livello madrelingua e conoscenza fluente del tedesco e dell'inglese; elevata presenza di clienti nella Svizzera romanda e collaborazione regolare con i team di Zurigo (sede di lavoro Zurigo o Ginevra)

Se hai domande, visita la nostra pagina delle FAQ o contatta Beata Czyzewska al +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49.

Per questo posto vacante consideriamo solo candidature dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi, quindi accogliamo con favore le candidature indipendentemente dal background personale.

SIX is driving the transformation of financial markets.

What distinguishes us is driving us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of the financial markets with us.

Senior Sales & Account Manager/in Banking Romandie (80-100%)

Geneva, Zurich, Up to 40% Home Office, Reference 8257

Do you want to actively shape the expansion of our customer relationships in Romandie? Do you have a strong network in the Swiss banking market and move confidently at the interface of customers, business and technology? As a senior sales & account manager banking Romandie, you continue to develop existing customer relationships, open up new business opportunities and successfully position our solutions in the areas of mars, bmc, TWINT, Fraud & Dispute as well as banking services in the market.

With your sense of customer needs and your entrepreneurial thinking, you make a significant contribution to the growth of our business in Western Switzerland.

These are your tasks

• Support and further development of a portfolio of banks and financial institutions in the Romandie

• Establish long-term customer relationships and identify and gain new business opportunities

• Development and implementation of customer and growth strategies and active participation in the market development in the noveldie

• Positioning and marketing our solutions in the areas of the areas of the mars & issuing services, bmc services, TWINT services, Fraud & Dispute services and banking & processing services

• Management of sales, supply and contract processes until successful completion and advice of banks on strategic, operational and technical issues

You bring this with you

• Several years of experience in sales, business development or account management in the financial services environment with sound knowledge of the Swiss banking market

• strong network of banks and financial institutions, preferably in the Romandy, as well as demonstrable successes in building new business and developing customer relationships

• Understanding modern banking, payment and platform solutions and the ability to communicate technical and business topics to the needs of the client

• strategic, entrepreneurial and self-responsible personality with high implementation strength, customer orientation, negotiation skills and safe appearance up to senior management level

• French at native language level and at the level of a total of nineteen English and German knowledge; high customer profile in Romandie and regular collaboration with the teams in Zurich (workplace Zurich or Geneva)

If you have any questions, please visit our FAQ page or contact Beata Czyzewska at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +3 91 333 51 49.

For this vacancy we take into account only direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we are happy about applications regardless of the personal background.

Genève, Zurich | Jusqu'à 40 % de bureau à domicile | Référence 8257

Vous disposez d'un réseau solide sur le marché bancaire suisse et êtes confiant à l'interface entre les clients, les affaires et la technologie ? En tant que Senior Sales & Account Manager Banking Suisse Romande, vous développerez les relations avec les clients existants, ouvrirez de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et positionnerez avec succès nos solutions dans les domaines des cartes, des ATM, de TWINT, de la fraude et des litiges ainsi que des services bancaires sur le marché. • Accompagnement et développement d'un portefeuille de banques et d'établissements financiers en Suisse romande

• Plusieurs années d'expérience en vente, développement commercial ou gestion de comptes dans le milieu des services financiers avec une connaissance approfondie du marché bancaire suisse

• Réseau solide auprès de banques et d'institutions financières, de préférence en Suisse romande, ainsi que réussite avérée dans la création de nouvelles affaires et le développement des relations avec la clientèle.

• Compréhension des solutions modernes de banque, de paiement et de plateforme, ainsi que capacité à transmettre des sujets techniques et commerciaux de manière appropriée.

• Personnalité stratégique, entrepreneuriale et responsable avec de grandes compétences de mise en œuvre, une orientation client, des compétences en négociation et une attitude confiante jusqu'au niveau de la haute direction

• Français de niveau natif ainsi que maîtrise de l'allemand et de l'anglais ; forte présence client en Suisse romande ainsi qu'une collaboration régulière avec les équipes à Zurich (lieu de travail Zurich ou Genève)

jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Account Manager

Zurich |  80-100% | Reference 8147

Do you want to work in a highly dynamic environment? Are you passionate about market data? Then our Account Management team wants to hear from you! We are an AGILE, DRIVEN and international team responsible for the licensing of market data across both legal entities SIX and BME. In this position you will work closely with Administration & Intelligence, Legal & Compliance and Operations.

What You Will Do

• Responsible for the holistic and service-oriented management of existing and new clients within the framework of proactive account management.

• Acting as the primary point of contact for clients, coordinating cross-functional teams (Product, Legal, Operations) to ensure seamless service delivery, while monitoring account performance and aligning solutions with client needs and business objectives.

• Building and maintaining sustainable client relationships.

• Driving commercial growth through upselling and cross-selling of market data services and value-added analytics offerings.

• Initiate and support client audits and assisting the external auditor in the preparation and execution of audit activities.

What You Bring

• Proven experience in the financial services industry (3-8 years).

• Solid background in the market data domain (e.g. data vendor, exchange or bank).

• Experience in account management, sales, or client relationship management.

• Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

• Fluent in German and English (both verbal & writing), Spanish or French is a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Beata Czyzewska  at +48 22 104 6571 / +41 58 399 9800 / +34 91 330 51 49 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

Gestione account

• Responsabile della gestione olistica e orientata al servizio dei clienti esistenti e nuovi nell'ambito della gestione dei conti proattivi.

jobs.title: AI Software Architect
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

AI Software Architect

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8259

Shape and execute the AI SDLC at SIX · reports to Head of Software Engineering Practices

Agentic AI is changing how software gets built — and at SIX, it will touch the work of more than thousand engineers. As AI Software Architect, you will set the technical direction for this shift: designing the reference patterns, tooling, and quality gates that make AI-augmented and agentic development safe and effective in a regulated financial market infrastructure, and driving adoption across teams you don't manage.

What You Will Do

• Translate the AI software engineering strategy into working practice. Design, prototype and harden the reference patterns, tooling and reusable components that make AI SDLC (augmented, agentic) real across SIX.

• Set the deepest technical standards for AI-based development: prompt and agent patterns, code review of AI-generated code, and the quality and security gates that make it safe in a regulated FMI.

• Support and execute the people transformation journey, evolving developer roles, team structures, processes and ways of working to unlock the full potential of AI-augmented software engineering

• Run lighthouse engagements hands-on: understand the process of business-unit software teams, baseline and measure impact on real backlogs, and prove value before scaling.

• Drive adoption across teams you don't manage. Coach senior engineers, win over skeptics, and lead the community of practice across CH, ES, PL and IN.

What You Bring

• 8+ years in software engineering with deep with current hands-on expertise across the entire SDLC. You still design software systems, write and review code, and engineers trust your technical judgment.

• Strong systems and architecture thinking across the end-to-end SDLC, and sound judgment on putting AI into a regulated, business-critical environment

• Hands-on experience with AI harness, LLM APIs and agent frameworks, including building custom workflows when off-the-shelf falls short. Claude Code hands-on experience in production is a plus.

• A track record of driving change through influence, not authority. You've won over skeptical senior engineers and spread practice across teams you didn't manage.

• Excellent stakeholder management, low ego and a teaching instinct — equally credible in a design review with a principal engineer and a risk conversation with security; fluent in English, German a plus.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

descriptionByLocale.it:

AI Software Architetto

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8259

Formare ed eseguire il SDLC AI a SIX · rapporti a capo delle pratiche di ingegneria del software

Agentic AI sta cambiando come il software viene costruito — e a SIX, toccherà il lavoro di più di mille ingegneri. Come AI Software Architect, si imposta la direzione tecnica per questo cambiamento: progettare i modelli di riferimento, strumenti e cancelli di qualità che rendono lo sviluppo AI-augmented e agentic sicuro ed efficace in un'infrastruttura di mercato finanziario regolamentata, e guidare l'adozione in team che non gestisci.

Cosa farai

• Traduci la strategia di ingegneria del software AI nella pratica di lavoro. Progettazione, prototipo e indurimento dei modelli di riferimento, utensili e componenti riutilizzabili che rendono AI SDLC (augmented, agentic) reale attraverso SIX.

• Impostare gli standard tecnici più profondi per lo sviluppo basato su AI: modelli di prompt e agente, la revisione del codice del codice generato dall'IA, e le porte di qualità e sicurezza che lo rendono sicuro in un FMI regolamentato.

• Sostenere ed eseguire il viaggio di trasformazione delle persone, l'evoluzione dei ruoli dello sviluppatore, le strutture del team, i processi e i modi di lavorare per sbloccare il pieno potenziale dell'ingegneria del software aumentata dall'IA

• Eseguire gli impegni del faro hands-on: capire il processo di business-unit software team, baseline e misura l'impatto su backlog reali, e dimostrare il valore prima di scaling.

• Guida l'adozione tra le squadre che non gestisci. Allenatori senior, vincere gli scettici, e guidare la comunità di pratica attraverso CH, ES, PL e IN.

Che cosa porta

• 8+ anni di ingegneria del software con profonda esperienza pratica in tutto il SDLC. Si progetta ancora sistemi software, scrivere e rivedere il codice, e gli ingegneri si fidano del vostro giudizio tecnico.

• Sistemi e architettura forti che pensano attraverso il SDLC end-to-end, e giudizio sonoro sul mettere l'IA in un ambiente regolamentato, business-critical

• Hands-on esperienza con imbracatura AI, API LLM e quadri di agente, tra cui la costruzione di flussi di lavoro personalizzati quando fuori-the-shelf cade breve. Claude Code esperienza pratica nella produzione è un vantaggio.

• Una traccia di cambiamento di guida attraverso l'influenza, non l'autorità. Hai vinto gli ingegneri senior scettici e la pratica di diffusione in squadre che non hai gestito.

• Eccellente gestione degli stakeholder, basso ego e un istinto di insegnamento — altrettanto credibile in una recensione di progettazione con un ingegnere principale e una conversazione di rischio con la sicurezza; fluente in inglese, tedesco un plus.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Mateusz Kozielec al numero +41583998611 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
SIX stimule la transformation des marchés financiers.

Ce qui nous distingue nous pousse vers l'avenir : entre les racines locales et la pertinence mondiale, nous sommes un mélange unique de tradition et d'avenir, de fondement et de croissance. Nous apprécions les esprits brillants et les inspirons à grandir avec leurs idées. Venez façonner l'avenir de la finance avec nous.

Architecte logiciel AI

Zurich: travail à domicile jusqu'à 40% possible

Former et exécuter le SDLC AI à SIX · rapports au responsable des pratiques d'ingénierie logicielle

L'IA agentique change la façon dont le logiciel se construit — et chez SIX, elle touchera le travail de plus de mille ingénieurs. En tant qu'architecte logiciel de l'IA, vous définirez la direction technique de ce changement : concevoir les modèles de référence, l'outillage et les barrières de qualité qui rendent le développement de l'IA sécuritaire et efficace dans une infrastructure de marché financier réglementée, et conduire l'adoption à travers les équipes que vous ne gérez pas.

Ce que vous ferez

• Traduire la stratégie d'ingénierie logicielle en pratique de travail. Concevoir, prototyper et durcir les modèles de référence, l'outillage et les composants réutilisables qui rendent AI SDLC (augmenté, agentique) réel sur SIX.

• Définir les normes techniques les plus profondes pour le développement basé sur l'IA : modèles d'agents rapides, révision de code du code généré par l'IA, et les barrières de qualité et de sécurité qui le rendent sûr dans un FMI réglementé.

• Soutenir et exécuter le parcours de transformation des personnes, l'évolution des rôles de développeur, les structures d'équipe, les processus et les façons de travailler pour libérer tout le potentiel de l'ingénierie logicielle augmentée par l'IA

• Exécuter des engagements de phare : comprendre le processus des équipes de logiciels de l'unité d'affaires, mesurer l'impact sur les arriérés réels et prouver la valeur avant l'échelle.

• Conduisez l'adoption à travers les équipes que vous ne gérez pas. Coach ingénieurs seniors, gagner les sceptiques, et diriger la communauté de pratique à travers CH, ES, PL et IN.

Ce que vous apportez

• 8+ ans en ingénierie logicielle avec une expertise pratique actuelle dans tout le SDLC. Vous concevez encore des systèmes logiciels, écrivez et revoyez le code, et les ingénieurs font confiance à votre jugement technique.

• Des systèmes et une architecture solides dans l'ensemble du SDLC de bout en bout, et un bon jugement sur la mise en place de l'IA dans un environnement réglementé et critique pour les entreprises

• Expérience pratique avec le harnais d'IA, les API LLM et les cadres d'agents, y compris la construction de workflows personnalisés lorsque hors de la plate-forme tombe à court. Claude Code expérience pratique dans la production est un plus.

• Une expérience de la conduite du changement par l'influence, pas l'autorité. Vous avez gagné sur les ingénieurs seniors sceptiques et réparti la pratique entre les équipes que vous n'avez pas gérées.

• Excellente gestion des parties prenantes, faible ego et un instinct d'enseignement — également crédible dans une revue de conception avec un ingénieur principal et une conversation de risque avec la sécurité; couramment en anglais, allemand un plus.

Si vous avez des questions, consultez notre page FAQ ou appelez Mateusz Kozielec au +4158399861 .

La diversité est importante pour nous. Par conséquent, nous cherchons à recevoir des demandes indépendamment de tout contexte personnel.

jobs.title: (Senior) IAM Business Analyst (80-100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

(Senior) IAM Business Analyst (80-100%)

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8269

Would you like to shape the future of IAM across workforce identities, cloud services and AI agents? As a Senior IAM Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer, you are an IAM specialist who understands SailPoint IdentityIQ well enough to shape feasible concepts and challenge technical options, while owning stakeholder alignment, requirements and processes. You bring together business, governance, data and technology perspectives, communicate confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and use data to support sound decisions. Working closely with IAM engineers, QA, operations, application owners, risk and audit, you turn emerging needs into sustainable processes and solutions. Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership and Trust guide how we work together and deliver value.

What You Will Do

• Translate business, risk and regulatory needs into clear functional and non-functional requirements, process models, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Shape and evolve IAM capabilities and governance models across workforce IAM, cloud services, non-human identities including AI agents as well as policy-based access control (PBAC), translating emerging needs into scalable processes and feasible solution concepts.

• Develop solution designs for SailPoint IdentityIQ by assessing platform capabilities, defining workflows and data flows, and aligning concepts with IAM engineers and architects.

• Analyze IAM data to identify trends, root causes, control gaps and automation opportunities, and present evidence-based recommendations.

• Act as the bridge between stakeholders and the distributed delivery team, supporting prioritisation, implementation, testing, rollout and adoption of sustainable IAM solutions.

What You Bring

• Several years of experience as an IAM Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer or Consultant in IAM, with strong knowledge of IAM and IGA, access governance, RBAC/ABAC/PBAC, role engineering, certifications, Segregation of Duties and relevant control requirements; experience with IAM aspects of cloud services or AI agents is an advantage.

• Practical knowledge of SailPoint IIQ/ISC and a sound understanding of systems and application architecture, including how corporate systems work together.

• Proven experience in requirements engineering, process modelling and the software development lifecycle, with sufficient technical literacy to assess feasibility, understand implementation approaches and constructively challenge technical proposals.

• Strong analytical and data skills, including SQL and BI tools (Python is an advantage), with the ability to turn complex information into sound decisions and clear recommendations.

• Confident communication and facilitation skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders in English; German is an advantage, combined with customer focus, ownership and attention to detail.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

(Senior) IAM Business Analyst (80-100%)

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8269

Vorresti plasmare il futuro dell'IM attraverso identità di forza lavoro, servizi cloud e agenti dell'AI? Come Senior IAM Business Analyst / Requisiti Engineer, sei uno specialista IAM che comprende SailPoint IdentityIQ abbastanza bene da modellare concetti fattibili e sfidare le opzioni tecniche, pur possedendo allineamento delle parti interessate, requisiti e processi. Unisci le prospettive di business, governance, dati e tecnologia, comunica con fiducia con gli stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici e utilizza i dati per supportare le decisioni sonore. Lavorando a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri IAM, QA, operazioni, proprietari di applicazioni, rischi e audit, si trasformano le esigenze emergenti in processi e soluzioni sostenibili. Focus del cliente, collaborazione, proprietà e fiducia guida come lavoriamo insieme e di fornire valore.

Cosa farai

• Traduci le esigenze aziendali, di rischio e di regolamentazione in requisiti funzionali e non funzionali chiari, modelli di processo, storie utente e criteri di accettazione.

• Formare ed evolvere le funzionalità IAM e i modelli di governance attraverso la forza lavoro IAM, i servizi cloud, le identità non umane, inclusi gli agenti AI e il controllo di accesso basato sulla politica (PBAC), traducendo le esigenze emergenti in processi scalabili e soluzioni possibili.

• Sviluppa progetti di soluzioni per SailPoint IdentityIQ valutando le capacità della piattaforma, definendo flussi di lavoro e flussi di dati, e allineando concetti con ingegneri e architetti IAM.

• Analizzare i dati IAM per identificare tendenze, cause radice, lacune di controllo e opportunità di automazione, e presentare raccomandazioni basate sulle prove.

• Agire come ponte tra le parti interessate e il team di distribuzione, sostenendo la priorità, l'implementazione, il test, l'implementazione e l'adozione di soluzioni IAM sostenibili.

Che cosa porta

• Diversi anni di esperienza come IAM Business Analyst, Requisiti Ingegnere o Consulente in IAM, con una forte conoscenza di IAM e IGA, governance di accesso, RBAC/ABAC/PBAC, ingegneria del ruolo, certificazioni, Segregazione di Duties e relativi requisiti di controllo; l'esperienza con gli aspetti IAM dei servizi cloud o agenti AI è un vantaggio.

• Conoscenza pratica di SailPoint IIQ/ISC e una solida comprensione dei sistemi e dell'architettura delle applicazioni, tra cui come i sistemi aziendali lavorano insieme.

• Provata esperienza nei requisiti di ingegneria, modellazione dei processi e ciclo di vita dello sviluppo del software, con sufficiente alfabetizzazione tecnica per valutare la fattibilità, comprendere gli approcci di attuazione e sfidare costruttivamente le proposte tecniche.

• Forte capacità analitiche e di dati, tra cui strumenti SQL e BI (Python è un vantaggio), con la capacità di trasformare le informazioni complesse in decisioni sonore e raccomandazioni chiare.

• Capacità di comunicazione e di facilitazione con stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici in inglese; il tedesco è un vantaggio, combinato con focus del cliente, la proprietà e l'attenzione ai dettagli.

Se hai domande, consulta la nostra pagina FAQ o chiama Julia Schmidt al numero +41583998670 .

Per questa vacanza accettiamo solo applicazioni dirette.

La diversità è importante per noi. Pertanto, stiamo cercando di ricevere applicazioni indipendentemente da qualsiasi background personale.

Möchten Sie die Zukunft von IAM über Mitarbeiteridentitäten, Cloud-Services und KI-Agenten hinweg gestalten? Als Senior IAM Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer sind Sie ein IAM-Spezialist, der SailPoint IdentityIQ gut genug versteht, um machbare Konzepte zu gestalten und technische Optionen herauszufordern, während Sie Stakeholder-Alignment, Anforderungen und Prozesse besitzen. Sie bringen Business-, Governance-, Daten- und Technologieperspektiven zusammen, kommunizieren vertrauensvoll mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern und verwenden Daten, um fundierte Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit IAM-Ingenieuren, QA, Operations, Application Ownern, Risiko und Audit verwandeln Sie aufkommende Anforderungen in nachhaltige Prozesse und Lösungen. Customer Focus, Collaboration, Ownership und Trust leiten, wie wir zusammenarbeiten und Werte liefern.

Was Sie tun werden

• Übersetzen Sie Geschäfts-, Risiko- und regulatorische Anforderungen in klare funktionale und nicht-funktionale Anforderungen, Prozessmodelle, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien.

• Gestalten und entwickeln Sie IAM-Fähigkeiten und Governance-Modelle für Workforce-IAM, Cloud-Services, nicht-menschliche Identitäten einschließlich KI-Agenten sowie Policy-based Access Control (PBAC) und übersetzen Sie aufkommende Anforderungen in skalierbare Prozesse und machbare Lösungskonzepte.

• Entwickeln Sie Lösungsdesigns für SailPoint IdentityIQ, indem Sie die Plattformfähigkeiten bewerten, Workflows und Datenflüsse definieren und die Konzepte mit IAM-Ingenieuren und Architekten abstimmen.

• Analysieren Sie IAM-Daten, um Trends, Ursachen, Kontrolllücken und Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten zu identifizieren und evidenzbasierte Empfehlungen zu präsentieren.

• Als Brücke zwischen Stakeholdern und dem verteilten Bereitstellungsteam fungieren und die Priorisierung, Implementierung, Erprobung, Einführung und Einführung nachhaltiger IAM-Lösungen unterstützen.

Was du mitbringst

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung als IAM Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder Consultant in IAM, mit fundierten Kenntnissen in IAM und IGA, Access Governance, RBAC/ABAC/PBAC, Rollenentwicklung, Zertifizierungen, Aufgabentrennung und relevanten Kontrollanforderungen; Erfahrung mit IAM-Aspekten von Cloud-Services oder KI-Agenten ist von Vorteil.

• Praktische Kenntnisse von SailPoint IIQ/ISC und ein fundiertes Verständnis von Systemen und Anwendungsarchitektur, einschließlich der Funktionsweise von Unternehmenssystemen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in Requirements Engineering, Prozessmodellierung und dem Softwareentwicklungslebenszyklus mit ausreichender technischer Kompetenz, um die Machbarkeit zu beurteilen, Implementierungsansätze zu verstehen und technische Vorschläge konstruktiv herauszufordern.

• Starke Analyse- und Datenkenntnisse, einschließlich SQL- und BI-Tools (Python ist ein Vorteil), mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Informationen in fundierte Entscheidungen und klare Empfehlungen umzuwandeln.

• Selbstbewusste Kommunikation und Unterstützung mit technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern in englischer Sprache; Deutsch ist ein Vorteil, kombiniert mit Kundenorientierung, Eigenverantwortung und Liebe zum Detail.

Strategia di testa e sviluppo commerciale Servizi

Zurigo | Lavorare da casa fino al 40% possibile | Riferimento 8043

Il capo dello sviluppo commerciale e della strategia forma e fornisce l'agenda di crescita di SIX Securities Services. Il ruolo guida iniziative strategiche trasversali, nuove creazione di business, partnership e opportunità M&A, assicurando che BSS sia posizionata come fornitore leader europeo di infrastrutture post-trade.

Operando in tutte le verticali del prodotto, traduce la strategia in esecuzione, sblocca nuove opportunità di ricavi e supporta la leadership senior nello sviluppo a lungo termine dell'unità aziendale.

Cosa farai

• Guidare l'esecuzione strategica: Traduci la strategia BSS in chiare roadmap, assicurando la consegna disciplinata, la gestione del rischio e risultati misurabili.

• Identificare e fornire opportunità di crescita: Espandi flussi di ricavi attraverso la compensazione, la custodia, la finanza dei titoli e servizi a valore aggiunto, compresi nuovi mercati e segmenti dei clienti.

• Partenariati leader e iniziative M&A: sviluppare partnership strategiche e gestire opportunità di crescita inorganiche dalla valutazione all'integrazione.

• Consiglia la leadership senior: fornire informazioni strategiche, casi aziendali e monitoraggio delle prestazioni per supportare il processo decisionale a livello esecutivo.

• Assicurare l’allineamento interfunzionale: promuovere la collaborazione tra le unità aziendali e rafforzare il posizionamento di SIX con i clienti e all’interno dell’ecosistema dei mercati dei capitali.

Che cosa porta

• Ampia strategia e esperienza di leadership: comprovato track record nella strategia aziendale, consulenza o sviluppo aziendale all'interno di infrastrutture di mercato finanziario o mercati di capitale.

• Forte messa a fuoco di esecuzione: capacità dimostrata di tradurre la strategia in priorità attuabili e fornire iniziative su larga scala con un impatto misurabile.

• Competenze del settore profondo: comprensione solida dei servizi post-trade, dinamica delle infrastrutture di mercato e ambiente normativo.

• Esperienza nei partenariati e M&A: esposizione manuale a partenariati strategici e crescita inorganica, tra cui sviluppo di casi aziendali e pianificazione di integrazione.

• Influenza e capacità di comunicazione: Capacità di coinvolgere e consigliare gli stakeholder anziani con credibilità; fluente in inglese (il tedesco è un forte vantaggio).

Der Head of Business Development & Strategy gestaltet und liefert die Wachstumsagenda von SIX Securities Services. • Strategische Umsetzung vorantreiben: Übersetzen Sie die BSS-Strategie in klare Roadmaps, um disziplinierte Umsetzung, Risikomanagement und messbare Ergebnisse zu gewährleisten.

• Wachstumschancen identifizieren und liefern: Erweitern Sie Umsatzströme in den Bereichen Clearing, Depot, Wertpapierfinanzierung und Mehrwertdienste, einschließlich neuer Märkte und Kundensegmente.

• Führen Sie Partnerschaften und M&A-Initiativen: Entwickeln Sie strategische Partnerschaften und verwalten Sie anorganische Wachstumschancen von der Bewertung bis zur Integration.

• Beratung von Führungskräften: Bereitstellung strategischer Erkenntnisse, Business Cases und Performance Monitoring zur Unterstützung der Entscheidungsfindung auf Führungsebene.

• Gewährleistung einer funktionsübergreifenden Ausrichtung: Förderung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen den Geschäftsbereichen und Stärkung der Positionierung von SIX bei Kunden und im Kapitalmarkt-Ökosystem.

Was du mitbringst

• Umfangreiche Strategie- und Führungserfahrung: Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in Unternehmensstrategie, Beratung oder Geschäftsentwicklung in Finanzmarktinfrastrukturen oder Kapitalmärkten.

• Starke Ausführungsorientierung: Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Strategie in umsetzbare Prioritäten zu übersetzen und große Initiativen mit messbarer Wirkung zu liefern.

• Tiefe Branchenexpertise: Solides Verständnis von Nachhandelsdienstleistungen, Marktinfrastrukturdynamik und regulatorischem Umfeld.

• Erfahrung in Partnerschaften und M&A: Hands-on Exposition gegenüber strategischen Partnerschaften und anorganischem Wachstum, einschließlich Business Case Entwicklung und Integrationsplanung.

• Einfluss- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Fähigkeit, hochrangige Stakeholder glaubwürdig zu engagieren und zu beraten; fließend Englisch (Deutsch ist ein großer Vorteil).

• Assurer l'alignement interfonctionnel : favoriser la collaboration entre les unités commerciales et renforcer le positionnement de SIX avec les clients et au sein de l'écosystème des marchés financiers.

Ce que vous apportez

• Expérience approfondie en matière de stratégie et de leadership : Expérience éprouvée en matière de stratégie d'entreprise, de consultation ou de développement d'entreprise au sein des infrastructures des marchés financiers ou des marchés de capitaux.

• Forte concentration sur l'exécution : Capacité démontrée de traduire la stratégie en priorités réalisables et de réaliser des initiatives à grande échelle ayant un impact mesurable.

• Expertise approfondie de l'industrie : Compréhension solide des services post-négociation, de la dynamique des infrastructures de marché et de l'environnement réglementaire.

• Expérience des partenariats et des fusions-acquisitions : Exposition directe aux partenariats stratégiques et à la croissance inorganique, y compris l'élaboration d'analyses de rentabilisation et la planification de l'intégration.

• Oversee the full lifecycle of cryptographic keys (generation to destruction)

What You Bring

• Experience with HSMs and key management platforms (e.g., Keyfactor, cloud KMS,Securesys,Thales,Entrust)

jobs.title: Specialist Market Control (100%)
jobs.description:
SIX treibt die Transformation der Finanzmärkte voran.

Was uns unterscheidet, treibt uns voran: Zwischen lokalen Wurzeln und globaler Relevanz sind wir eine einzigartige Mischung aus Tradition und Zukunft, aus Fundament und Wachstum. Wir schätzen kluge Köpfe und inspirieren sie, mit ihren Ideen zu wachsen. Komm und gestalte die Zukunft der Finanzmärkte mit uns.

Specialist Market Control (100%)

Zurich |  vor Ort | Referenz 8295

Möchtest du in einem dynamischen Umfeld arbeiten und den fairen Handel an der Börse aktiv mitgestalten?Wir suchen dich als Specialist Market Control um den ordnungsgemässen Handel an der SIX Swiss Exchange sicherzustellen.

Werde Teil eines Teams, das Transparenz, Effizienz und Fairness im Handel grossschreibt.

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit mit Erfahrung im Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld/Börse/Handel mit Eigenmotivation sowie flexiblem Denk- und Handlungsvermögen (laufender Handel und Spät- /Abendschicht). Bist du bereit für diese spannende und abwechslungsreiche Rolle? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbungsunterlagen!

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Steuerung der Börsenperioden und Unterbrechung des Handels zur Sicherstellung eines fairen und ordnungsgemässen Handels

• Aufbereitung von Mistrade-Entscheidungen, inkl. Berechnung von Preisen und Abweichungen

• Anpassung von Handelsparametern in besonderen Marktsituationen

• Kommunikation und Anweisungserteilung an Teilnehmer:innen in speziellen Situationen

• Aktive Überwachung des Börsenbetriebs und Bereitstellung eines telefonischen Helpdesks.

Das bringst du mit

• Ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Finanzwirtschaft, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Börsenhandel oder in der Analyse, idealerweise in der Schweiz

• Fundiertes Wissen über die Schweizer Finanzmärkte und deren regulatorische Anforderungen

• Analytisches Denken und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Marktinformationen zu interpretieren

• Teamgeist, Eigeninitiative und ein hohes Mass an Verantwortungsbewusstsein

• Fliessende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, Französischkenntnisse sind ein Plus

•  Bereitschaft zu verlängerten Arbeitszeiten bis 22:00 Uhr.

Bei Fragen besuche unsere FAQ-Seite oder kontaktiere Julia Schmidt  unter der Nummer +41583998670.

Für diese Vakanz berücksichtigen wir ausschliesslich Direktbewerbungen.

Diversität ist uns wichtig, daher freuen wir uns über Bewerbungen unabhängig vom persönlichen Hintergrund.

Zurigo | on site | Riferimento 8295

Vuoi lavorare in un ambiente dinamico e modellare attivamente il commercio equo sul mercato azionario? Siamo alla ricerca di voi come Controllo di Mercato Specialista per garantire un corretto trading sulla SIX Swiss Exchange.

Diventa parte di un team che valorizza la trasparenza, l'efficienza e la correttezza del commercio.

• Gestione dei periodi di scambio azionario e interruzione del trading per garantire un commercio equo e ordinato

• Preparazione delle decisioni di Mistrade, compreso il calcolo dei prezzi e delle deviazioni

• Adattamento dei parametri di trading in particolari situazioni di mercato

• Comunicazione e istruzione ai partecipanti: dentro in situazioni particolari

• Monitorare attivamente le operazioni di mercato azionario e fornire una scrivania di assistenza telefonica.

Lo porti con te.

• Una laurea completa in finanza, economia o un campo comparabile

• Spirito di squadra, iniziativa e alto grado di responsabilità

What makes us different drives us forward: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique mixture of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value smart minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of financial markets with us.

Specialist Market Control (100%)

Zurich | on site | Reference 8295

Do you want to work in a dynamic environment and actively shape fair trading on the stock market? We are looking for you as Specialist Market Control to ensure proper trading on the SIX Swiss Exchange.

Become part of a team that values transparency, efficiency and fairness in trade.

We are looking for a personality with experience in the financial services environment / stock exchange / trading with self-motivation as well as flexible thinking and action (ongoing trading and late / evening shift). Are you ready for this exciting and varied role? Then we look forward to your application documents!

These are your tasks

• Management of stock exchange periods and interruption of trading to ensure fair and orderly trading

• Preparation of Mistrade decisions, including calculation of prices and deviations

• Adaptation of trading parameters in particular market situations

• Communication and instruction to participants: inside in special situations

• Actively monitor stock market operations and provide a telephone help desk.

You bring that with you

• A completed degree in finance, economics or a comparable field

• Several years of experience in stock trading or analysis, ideally in Switzerland

• In-depth knowledge of Swiss financial markets and their regulatory requirements

• Analytical thinking and the ability to interpret complex market information

• Team spirit, initiative and a high degree of responsibility

• Fluent German and English skills, French skills are a plus

• Readiness for extended working hours until 22:00.

If you have any questions, visit our FAQ page or contact Julia Schmidt on +41583998670.

For this vacancy, we only consider direct applications.

Diversity is important to us, so we welcome applications regardless of personal background.

Contrôle spécialisé des marchés (100 %)

Zurich sur place.Référence 8295

Voulez-vous travailler dans un environnement dynamique et façonner activement le commerce équitable sur le marché boursier? Nous vous recherchons en tant que Spécialiste du Contrôle du Marché pour assurer une bonne négociation sur la SIX Swiss Exchange.

Devenez membre d'une équipe qui valorise la transparence, l'efficacité et l'équité dans le commerce.

Nous recherchons une personnalité avec une expérience dans l'environnement des services financiers / bourse / trading avec l'automotivation ainsi que la pensée et l'action flexibles (le trading en cours et le quart de soirée). Êtes-vous prêt pour ce rôle passionnant et varié? Ensuite, nous attendons avec impatience vos documents de candidature!

• Communication et instruction aux participants: à l'intérieur dans des situations particulières

jobs.title: Head Fraud Services (100%)
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Head Fraud Services (100%)

Zurich |  bis zu 40% Home Office möglich | Reference 8286

Möchtest du die Sicherheit im Kartengeschäft aktiv mitgestalten und zwei Teams führen, die Betrugsfälle bearbeiten sowie Fraud-Risiken frühzeitig erkennen und wirksam begrenzen? Dann übernimm die Leitung unserer Teams Fraud Services (Monitoring) und Fraud Intelligence.

Als Head Fraud Services verantwortest du die fachliche und personelle Führung der Teams Fraud Services (Monitoring)  und Fraud Intelligence. Du stellst einen zuverlässigen operativen Betrieb sicher, steuerst die Weiterentwicklung der Fraud Detection und Prevention und förderst die Zusammenarbeit mit internen sowie externen Partnern.

Das sind deine Aufgaben

• Fachliche und personelle Führung sowie Weiterentwicklung der Teams Fraud Services und Fraud Intelligence

• Sicherstellung des operativen Fraud Monitorings, der Bearbeitung von Betrugsverdachtsfällen und des Fraud Incident Managements

• Steuerung der Analyse neuer Fraud-Trends sowie der Definition, Priorisierung und Wirksamkeitsmessung geeigneter Gegenmassnahmen

• Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung des Rule Managements, der Fraud Prevention Prozesse sowie der relevanten Reports und KPIs

• Zusammenarbeit mit Banken, Schemes, Behörden sowie internen und externen Partnern und Vertretung des Bereichs in relevanten Gremien

• Fraud Incident Management bei Fraud Attacken

Das bringst du mit

• Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder höhere Weiterbildung mit ausgewiesener Berufserfahrung im Finanz- oder Kartengeschäft

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Fraud Management, vorzugsweise im Bereich Debitkarten und TWINT.

• Führungserfahrung sowie die Fähigkeit, Teams zielorientiert zu entwickeln und Veränderungen wirksam umzusetzen

• Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten verbunden mit einer strukturierten, qualitätsorientierten Arbeitsweise

• Klare und professionelle Kommunikation sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

jobs.title: Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%
jobs.description:
SIX drives the transformation of financial markets.

What sets us apart drives us ahead: between local roots and global relevance, we are a unique blend of tradition and future, of foundation and growth. We value bright minds and inspire them to grow with their ideas. Come and shape the future of finance with us.

Senior Web Access Management Engineer 80-100%

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% | Reference 8237

Are you passionate about secure web access, identity, and modern authentication technologies? Then our Web Access Management team wants to hear from you. We are a collaborative and security-focused team responsible for protecting access to business-critical web applications and APIs. Our goal is to provide stable, secure, and continuously improving access services across reverse proxy, web application firewall, and customer identity platforms. In this role, you will work closely with application teams, security architects, platform engineers, and service owners to design, operate, and enhance secure access patterns in a regulated environment.

What You Will Do

• Operate and enhance Web Access Management services, including reverse proxy, access gateway, web application firewall, and customer identity components.

• Design, build, and troubleshoot secure authentication and single sign-on flows based on OpenID Connect, OAuth2, and SAML 2.0.

• Configure routing, TLS certificates, access policies, authorization mappings, and upstream integrations for web applications and APIs.

• Tune and maintain web application firewall policies, including OWASP Core Rule Set handling, exceptions, anomaly scoring, and change control.

• Contribute to operational stability, automation, monitoring, incident response, upgrades, disaster recovery readiness, and continuous service improvement.

What You Bring

• Strong hands-on knowledge of reverse proxy or access gateway platforms, including TLS handling, routing, header and cookie management, session handling, and high-availability operations.

• Practical experience with web application firewall technologies, ModSecurity, OWASP Core Rule Set, rule tuning, false-positive handling, and secure publishing patterns.

• Solid understanding of customer identity and access management, identity lifecycle, multi-factor authentication, secure account recovery, token validation, and authorization models.

• Good knowledge of federation and access protocols such as OpenID Connect, OAuth2, SAML 2.0, JWT, PKCE, scopes, claims, certificates, metadata, and key rotation.

• Analytical, security-minded, and collaborative working style, with good communication skills; fluent English is required, German is an advantage.

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Julia Schmidt  at +41583998670 .

For this vacancy we only accept direct applications.

Diversity is important to us. Therefore, we are looking to receiving applications regardless of any personal background.

IT Workplace Support Specialist

Zurich |  100% | Reference 7977

About the role

For our Workplace IT team, we are looking for a hands-on Level 2 Onsite Supporter who ensures stable, reliable, and user centric IT services at our Zurich site.

You act as a key contact point for our employees on site, handle complex support cases, and contribute to the continuous improvement and standardization of our workplace environment in close collaboration with central IT teams and external partners.

What You Will Do

• provide onsite 2nd level support (and backup for 1st level when required) for Windows 11 clients and standard workplace services

• handle incidents and service requests via ITSM, including IMACD activities and escalation coordination

• install, replace, and troubleshoot end user devices (laptops, monitors, docking stations, peripherals)

• support Microsoft 365, Active Directory / Azure AD user and access management

• operate and support printers, meeting rooms, and collaboration technology (Teams Rooms, video conferencing)

• support Endpoint Management (Intune / Microsoft Endpoint Manager) for device enrollment, compliance checks, and software assignments

• contribute to workplace standardization and lifecycle management (devices, accessories, meeting rooms)

• support rollouts, pilots, and refresh cycles in cooperation with central engineering teams

• ensure accurate documentation of solutions, processes, and how tos

• work closely with 3rd level engineering, service providers, and internal stakeholders

• support smaller workplace IT projects and continuous improvement initiatives

• act as a reliable onsite counterpart for central initiatives and standards

What You Bring

• 2–4+ years of experience in onsite IT support or IT service desk (Level 1/2) in enterprise environments

• strong hands-on skills in Windows 11, Microsoft 365 (Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, SharePoint)

• practical experience with hardware support and structured rollouts

• solid understanding of Active Directory / Azure AD and basic Intune tasks

• basic networking knowledge (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLAN fundamentals) for onsite troubleshooting

• experience working with ticketing and asset processes, SLA oriented mindset

• high service orientation, reliability, structured working style, and clear communication

• German fluent (spoken and written); good English for documentation and support interaction

• ITIL Foundation or comparable certification

• experience in large enterprise environments

• know how around Microsoft Teams Rooms and meeting room technology

• English certification (e.g. Cambridge B2 / C1)

Zurich |  Working from home up to 40% possible | Reference 8165

We are looking for a hands-on Messaging Platform Engineer to join our team in Zürich. A core responsibility of this role is the ongoing operation, maintenance and development of our business-critical on-premises IBM MQ Appliance environment. Alongside this established platform, our next step is to expand our messaging portfolio across OpenShift and Microsoft Azure. Beyond IBM MQ, we are also evaluating complementary cloud-native messaging technologies for the future hybrid messaging portfolio. This role combines platform engineering with software development. Your experience does not need to be limited to IBM MQ.

• Operate and improve the IBM MQ Appliance platform

• Build automation, self-service capabilities and platform services

• Design and implement IBM MQ services in OpenShift and Azure

• Evaluate complementary messaging technologies

• Develop automation using APIs, CI/CD and infrastructure as code

• Troubleshoot production issues and participate in on-call rotation

What You Bring

• Enterprise messaging platform administration or engineering experience

• Production experience in OpenShift or public cloud environments

• Automation or software engineering skills in Java and Spring Boot

• Strong Linux, container, networking and security fundamentals

• Experience with CI/CD, observability and incident management

• Knowledge of Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform or cloud-native messaging

If you have any questions, check out our FAQ page or call Mateusz Kozielec  at +41583998611 .
